name: mirage
text:
The PropLine grader is built and tested, but not released yet. It will go out with the next app release (I'm not cutting one while the other session is mid-work).

When a bet's game can't be graded from the usual score feeds, the app and the GitHub engine now ask PropLine's /bets/settle. It covers moneylines, spreads, game totals and team totals, including alternate lines. It only uses a clean won, lost, push or void answer. Half wins, half losses, unmatched or pending answers, props and first-half lines are left alone, so a bet it can't settle stays open for you to mark. Tests pass: the answer parsing, the request building, and the app and engine wiring. Logged in CHANGES.md with a revert rule.
